create_ASE_Multiview_dataset: create an ASE_Multiview dataset instance with configurable num_views and window_size for multi-view stereo training
create_ASE_Multiview_Simple_dataset: create an ASE_Multiview_Simple dataset with a sliding window of contiguous frames from a single scene
read_trajectory_file: read a CSV trajectory file and return positions, rotations, transforms, and timestamps as numpy arrays
get_rotation_matrix_z: get a 4x4 rotation matrix for k times 90 degrees clockwise rotation about the Z axis
adjust_intrinsics_for_90_clockwise_rotat: adjust camera intrinsics matrix after rotating an image 90 degrees clockwise
